profile.name: BioShake微孔板恒温振荡器
profile.description: BioShake 是用于微孔板的加热振荡一体化实验室设备，可在设定温度下对孔板进行振荡混匀，并可通过锁板机构固定孔板以防移位；常用于酶促反应、孵育、混匀、样品制备等流程。
profile.description_en: BioShake is an integrated microplate heater shaker used to mix microplates by orbital shaking while controlling the plate temperature. It can clamp/lock the plate to prevent movement during shaking, and is commonly used for incubation, enzymatic reactions, mixing, and sample preparation workflows.

registry.name: BioShake iQ Microplate Shaker
registry.description: BioShake iQ Microplate Shaker 恒温摇床是由Q.Instruments (Analytik Jena)生产的恒温摇床，主要功能包括停止、冷却、复位、归零、温度设置、电流读取。
